description: Fischer-Tropsch low-temperature (LTFT) reactor equilibrium conversion model with ASF chain-growth distribution for C8-C16 jet fuel selectivity.

unit.name: Generic LTFT Co/Al2O3 Reactor, 200-230 degC, 20-30 bar
unit.source: Dry (2002) Catalysis Today; Schulz (1999) Applied Catalysis A; Anderson (1956); De Klerk (2011) Fischer-Tropsch Refining, Wiley-VCH.

T_opt.note: Optimal FT reactor temperature (LTFT Co catalyst: 200-230 C)

X_max.note: Maximum per-pass CO conversion (LTFT with recycle: 0.80-0.92, Dry 2002)

k_T.note: Gaussian width for temperature sensitivity (narrow for LTFT)

P_exp.note: Pressure exponent (positive: higher P favors FT, Le Chatelier)

alpha_ASF.note: ASF chain-growth probability (LTFT Co: 0.85-0.92 gives high C5+ fraction)

H2_CO_ratio.note: H2/CO ratio in syngas feed (stoichiometric FT: ~2.0-2.15)

LHV_FT_kJ_mol.note: LHV per mol C12H26 (C12 surrogate for jet fuel, LHV=44 MJ/kg * 170 g/mol = 7480 kJ/mol; ~7800 for isoparaffins)
